summary: Best 28.841 (r2b2_t1 at 6,751M; incumbent 28.628): a greedy episode dives through the -y tunnel to its west end (the field route's physical limit ~28.8%). Analysis: the field route past 28.6% is closed; the WR demo (analysis only) shows a ~2,000 u dip into a cavity with a surf-ramp turnaround. New generic sampler options --respawn-novel-turn / --respawn-novel-band put ~85% of novel rows in that dip; the bench shows the return leg learned. With T capped at 1 the training ceiling jumped 28,205 -> 29,027 u (a real episode past the tunnel).
